project.name: PANDA
project.tagline: Protecting consumers from dark patterns with local AI
project.oneLiner: A browser extension AI agent that detects and neutralizes dark patterns in real time, powered by a local neurosymbolic model — no cloud, no tracking, full privacy.
project.problem: Dark patterns are deceptive UI designs that manipulate users into unintended actions — hidden fees, forced subscriptions, misleading opt-ins. They cost consumers billions annually and erode trust in digital products. Existing tools are limited to static blocklists that can't keep up with evolving tactics.
project.solution: PANDA is a browser extension that uses a local neurosymbolic AI model to detect dark patterns in real time as users browse. It highlights manipulative elements, explains the tactic being used, and offers a clean alternative — empowering informed decisions without sending any data to the cloud.
project.approach: Our neurosymbolic architecture combines neural pattern recognition with symbolic reasoning over UI semantics. The model runs entirely on-device, ensuring privacy and low latency. We validate against a curated taxonomy of dark pattern categories from established HCI research.
